per_cell.end_cycle: k* (certified) or the cap (uncertified); every per-cell value below is read at the end cycle

per_cell.first_k0_v2: the run's first residual pass under the version-2 definition (holds and dynamic cap keyed on it)
per_cell.first_k0_alpha: the first k0 of the reading-alpha rule
per_cell.band: [min, max] Q over the certifying window (uncertified: over the last L = 60 cycles)
per_cell.s: gated cells: s = Q(end) - Q_N_old (Q_N_old = the ORIGINAL record's last cycle); ungated: undefined
per_cell.Q_net: net_operational_recourse of the end cycle (per_cycle_record recourse)
per_cell.non_optimal_cycles: cycles whose all_optimal_k is False (every block's final exit; ESSO included)
per_cell.terminal_step_to_threshold: |dQ_last| / EPS0; range / tau at k* (certified); production's rule ten (objective_change_abs / objective_tolerance) of the last row (CLAUDE.md)
per_cell.pf_primal_slope_last_50: OLS slope of boyd_pf_primal_ratio on the cycle over the last 50 cycles ending at the end cycle (per_cycle_record; report-only)
per_cell.arm: the E arm (W134 arm definitions table); None for pb
per_cell.model_variant: the arm's model_variant, applied in the child and read back (G9 replacement)

per_cell.EFC: p515_s46_ageing_mechanism.pv(efc_per_day per block), the same source

uncertified_form.frozen_v2_form: band [min, max] over the last L = 60 cycles; drift rate = mean dQ over the last 25; dQ_cc rate = mean (dQ + dt_sum) over the same cycles; t_sum and Q_cc at the cap; reasons
uncertified_form.gap_refused_cell: a cell uncertified at its cap with at least one gap-clause refusal (decision gap_refusals non-empty) -- Addendum 58 Ruling 1, generalised
uncertified_form.gap_refused_label: objective settled; interface-consensus gap unresolved (degenerate dual)
uncertified_form.gap_refused_carries: the label; the pf-primal slope over the last 50 cycles; t_by_node at the cap; the drift rate; the dQ_cc rate; gap = |t_sum at the cap|; slack = |s| (gated)
uncertified_form.determinacy_rule: a difference involving an uncertified cell is DETERMINATE iff its margin exceeds BAR = 3 x max(|gap_u|, |slack_u|) over the uncertified cell(s) u of the difference in BOTH gross and Q_cc terms (Addendum 58 Ruling 1; as W130 applied it: 3 x max(9,234.42, 1,461.49) = 27,703.27); margin_Qcc = |d_Qcc| if sign(d_Qcc) == sign(d_Q), else -|d_Qcc|; an ungated uncertified cell has no slack -> INDETERMINATE (slack undefined)

claims.source: W117 claims (w117_triage_recompute.json, 3b2e76de): the 11 item-E claims and the Phase B claim C:y2025__n5_p0.25_e0.5, each with its W117 definition (form, I_ref, I_other, net_of_salvage); the cells are this campaign's (the original eval keys mapped to the W135 cells) and the settled x0 reference (d110bd1a for 7aa017f0)

claims.form_value: d = [Q(r) - Q(o)] - [I(o) - I(r)] (value - I; delta-value - delta-I)

claims.net_beside: d_net: the F form with Q_net (G rows: primary per the claim's own convention, the other beside)
claims.resolution_settled_vs_settled: both cells certified (settled): resolution = band_r + band_o (the sum of the two band widths); determinate iff |d| > resolution (gross verdict; Q_cc beside, report-only)
claims.resolution_with_an_uncertified_cell: the determinacy rule of the uncertified form (above)
claims.verdict_words: determinate | within resolution | indeterminate (slack undefined) | not scored (a cell has no result yet)

definitions.weighted_resolution: UNCHANGED in v6 (Addendum 61 rules differences between two certified cells; its extension to this weighted three-cell difference is not ruled -- recorded for the Planner). Worker generalisation of W132's rule to a difference sum_i c_i Q_i over three cells (the expert prediction): all certified -> resolution = sum_i |c_i| band_i (W132's sum of the two band widths when |c_i| = 1), gross verdict, Q_cc beside; any uncertified ungated cell -> indeterminate (slack undefined); an uncertified gated cell -> bar = 3 x max(|c_i| gap_i, |c_i| slack_i) over the uncertified cells, both terms (W132's form when |c_i| = 1). FOR PLANNER CONFIRMATION
